assertions.text: Recognizes the round budget is exhausted but, because `review_findings_generate_issues` is `false` (the default), fixes the finding anyway rather than filing it -- explicitly states the "fix everything" default holds even past the nominal round budget, since `max_rounds` only stops this skill from proactively triggering more rounds, it doesn't give a real finding a free pass
Does not treat budget exhaustion alone as equivalent to one of the three named exceptions
